advancement_rule: Advance every system with at least two geometry-ready transiting planets and at least one dedicated GBT primary-target cadence listing containing six distinct scan MJDs and at least six gpuspec.0002.h5 products. Do not choose among advancing systems until a separately frozen header-only conjunction comparison. No linked radio file may be opened in LS3.
